newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Rugby Union-Big run on tickets for Super 12 opener.
newsitem.headline: Rugby Union-Big run on tickets for Super 12 opener.

text.p: PALMERSTON NORTH, Dec 20 - Rugby fans wanting tickets in the grandstand at the Showgrounds Oval for the Super 12 opener between the Wellington Hurricanes and the Waikato Chiefs on February 28 are already out of luck, NZPA reports.
They sold out in a day and the remaining 120 $25 tickets were being held until today for 15-year and season ticketholders.
Manawatu Rugby Football Union office spokeswoman Prue Christie said demand had gone crazy this week.
The tickets hadn't even been advertised. They were only the subject of a newspaper article last week after the Hurricanes had advised tickets were being printed.
Sales opened on Monday morning and by 4pm public sales had to be stopped.
"All we've done all week is sell tickets," Christie said.
"We hadn't expected to start selling until February. This is totally unprecedented."

The grandstand seats about 4200. Even many of the $15 ground admission tickets have gone and 200 of the 2000 temporary seats meaning almost half of the oval's capacity has been sold already. Other Hurricanes' unions have had to have their allocations reduced.
The demand is believed to have been due to the spectacular sellout success of the first Super 12 opener between the Hurricanes and Auckland Blues in Palmerston North last March.
